author: Phipps, 1774
summary: 몸 전체가 흰 갈매기로, 몸 크기는 괭이갈매기보다 작은 편이다. 유라시아 대륙과 북아메리카의 북극권에 분포한다.

points.en: black-based bill with a yellow tip
black spots scattered on back and upperwing

art.subject: Ivory Gull (Pagophila eburnea): all-white plumage with black spots scattered over the back, upperwing and primaries, black lores, black-based bill with a yellow tip
views: side view standing: white body, black-spotted back and wings, black lores, black-based bill with yellow tip
in flight from above: white wings with scattered black spots, black spots on the primaries

sources.title: 국립생물자원관 종 설명 – 북극흰갈매기
sources.used: 몸길이, 국내 상태, 생김새, 사는 곳, 먹이, 번식, 분포
